scope: Local PR1718 compiler: all FeVM workspace tests and frame/state corpus at O2; library, CLI and arithmetic at O0/O1/O2. Published master has separate full seven-stage acceptance.

manifest.publication: local merge of published Fe master and PR1718; provide --fe-repository /home/sean/code/fe

compiler_build.source_status_scope: tracked files; the build uses an untracked node_modules symlink
compiler_build.preparation: Existing locked npm tree-sitter dependencies shared from main checkout; no tracked source edits

frames.scope: outcome, remaining gas, output, completed stack/active memory; simultaneous-fault reasons retained separately; external state is not compared

state.scope: frame results, watched persistent/transient/original state, warmness, signed refunds, nested checkpoints and transaction settlement; signed envelopes and CALL/CREATE are excluded

cli.scope: native FeVM CLI smoke, not Cancun conformance
